_instance_note: instance N shifts every LOCAL port we bind (cmdapi.localPort, library ssh.localPort) by N, for a second agent on one host; vmPort stays the explicit per-host port. Omit or 0 for a single agent.
_pool_note: vmPortSpan = how many VM ports from vmPort up the tunnel may float through when its own is held (a host that slept leaves its old session on the VM). cmdapi defaults to 6; ssh to 1, its port is typed by hand. Keep the hosts' vmPorts at least a span apart.

ssh._mode_note: library = embedded ssh2 server; system = tunnel to this host's own sshd (default localPort 22, needs sshd installed, no authorizedKeys needed)
